shellCommands.command: ls /workspace/node_modules | head -50; echo "---"; cat /workspace/.gitignore; echo "---"; ls -la /workspace/__agent_eval__

set -e
echo "-- add book 1 --"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books --data 'title=Project Hail Mary&author=Andy Weir&notes=Recommended by a friend' | head -5
echo "-- add book 2 --"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books --data 'title=Dune&author=Frank Herbert' | head -5
echo "-- home page --"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'book-row|Add a book' -A2

ID=94cefed5-68e9-4dd1-a8d9-f6edde70b7aa
echo "-- book page --"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/book/$ID
echo
echo "-- update notes --"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/notes --data 'notes=Loved the science, great twist at the end.' | head -3
echo "-- mark finished --"
curl -s -i -X POST http://localhost:3000/books/$ID/finish | head -3
echo "-- home page after finish --"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'Currently Reading|Finished|book-row' -A2
echo "-- 404 for bad id --"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000/book/does-not-exist

cat /workspace/data/books.json
kill %1 2>/dev/null
sleep 0.3
node /workspace/server.js & sleep 0.5
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'Project Hail Mary|Dune'
kill %1 2>/dev/null

pkill -f "node server.js" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "node /workspace/server.js" 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.5
node /workspace/server.js &
sleep 0.5
echo "-- restarted, checking data persisted --"
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'Currently Reading|Finished|book-row' -A2
pkill -f "node /workspace/server.js" 2>/dev/null
echo done

pgrep -fa "node.*server.js" || echo "no server running"
node /workspace/server.js > /tmp/server.log 2>&1 &
sleep 0.6
curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -E 'Currently Reading|Finished|book-row' -A2
echo "---log---"
cat /tmp/server.log
ls /workspace; echo "---"; ls /workspace/data 2>/dev/null || echo "no data dir"
